issues.before: Works were accessible only from a select; new/imported/examples had no shelf or preparation entry.
issues.after: Grouped local cards with metadata, basic cover and explicit edit/prepare/start/resume actions.

issues.before: Switching works always selected the first cut; only current work context persisted.
issues.after: Existing storage envelope gains independent per-work editor position/tool/profile and read path.

issues.before: Planning, metadata and memos changed the whole-project save fingerprint.
issues.after: playback-v2 compares playback content; old unchanged fingerprints stay readable; real story changes still require compatibility check.

issues.before: Hiding the retained runtime using display:none gave RenPy a zero display size and GL2 resize exception.
issues.after: Persistent iframe is parked offscreen with positive dimensions, visibility/inert/aria-hidden; real shelf/reload/resume journey passes.

issues.before: Changing basic cover data could risk replacing advanced cover fields; memo single cut parent could appear as duplicate destination.
issues.after: Immutable partial merges preserve advanced design/composition/preset and memo fields/links; single paired parent is treated as context.

issues.before: Example edits and same-id file imports could be confused with another independent work.
issues.after: Example card editing makes a new-ID own copy; shelf duplicate import retains original and explains opening the existing card.

issues.before: Theme text on bright classic thumbnail images had low contrast.
issues.after: Classic thumbnail title uses a readable paper panel with ink text.

limits: Installed Chrome viewport tests, not actual Android hardware performance
Advanced cover data is preserved; advanced canvas designer/start-cover playback are outside this goal
Same project-ID shelf import is refused to preserve original
